findings.issue: Mailpit-down fallback is a FAIL, not a skip. complete_verification returns {ok:False, skipped:True}, but _email_step does step('email_verify', ok or required is False) and returns False, so step pass=False and the e2e aborts before login. Criterion requires the email e2e to SKIP cleanly with a clear message. (It does not hang: reachable() uses a 2s timeout and latest_message has a deadline.)
findings.fix_hint: In _email_step, if r.get('skipped'): record step('email_verify', True, skipped=r['reason']) and decide how to continue (or end the e2e as skipped) rather than failing. Add a test with a fake unreachable EmailProvider.

findings.issue: complete_verification (link branch, OTP branch, off-allowlist-link-only email, provider-unreachable, captcha) has no test; only extractors and the provider are covered. The committed e2e reports method=otp only, so the live link path is not reproducible from the repo. Safety point 1 is true by construction (extract_link drops non-allowlisted hosts; goto also runs under guard_context) but the end-to-end behavior with an off-allowlist-only email (expect reason=no_link_or_code_in_email, no navigation) is unproven.
findings.fix_hint: Add a FakeProvider (proves pluggability too) plus a Playwright page fixture or stub; assert no goto for evil host, link method works, and skipped result when reachable() is False.

findings.issue: register_secret(otp) runs only at the end, after fill/click. Any exception or print in between is not redacted. The link token is never registered.
